component.name: WineGUI
component.summary: WineGUI is a user-friendly WINE graphical interface

description.p: WineGUI is a friendly interface for Wine, letting you easily manage your Wine machines/bottles.
Features include an easy step-by-step wizard for creating a new machine, a built-in application list, editing machines and configuring a machine with a single click, and much more.

ul.li: Use the selected Wine runner and matching wineserver consistently when creating, configuring and launching bottles, running Winetricks and opening generated shortcuts.
Report incomplete custom Wine installations instead of silently falling back to system Wine.
Automatically repair WineGUI-managed shortcuts to use the bottle's current runner settings.
Preserve literal paths and arguments in desktop shortcuts and improve runner-selection regression coverage.
Restore standard Wine start launching for applications with CPU core limits while retaining taskset integration.
Add per-bottle CPU core limits for Wine and GE-Proton/UMU launches and managed shortcuts.
Improve launch argument handling, shortcut updates and bottle editing while applications are running.
Bound wineserver waits and reap launch helper processes.
Add an installer for the signed WineGUI APT repository on supported Debian, Ubuntu and compatible derivatives.
Fix launching the wrong application when the application list is filtered.
Improve automatic APT repository setup for supported Debian and Ubuntu derivatives, including Linux Mint.
Repair repository sources skipped by version 4.3.3 while preserving administrator changes.
Add the official signed WineGUI APT repository for supported Debian and Ubuntu releases.
Add distribution-specific package versions and protect repository trust and administrator configuration during upgrades.
Fix AppImage desktop actions by bundling and selecting the matching GLib desktop launcher helper.
Add packaging checks for the desktop launcher helper and startup hook.
Fix RPM dependencies and shared-directory ownership for Fedora and openSUSE.
Use the current 7zip dependency in RPM and Debian packages.
Integrate GE-Proton through a WineGUI-managed UMU launcher with automatic installation and updates.
Initialize Proton prefixes and runtime environments without requiring Steam.
Improve runner discovery, download recovery, architecture validation and error reporting.
Make subsequent WineGUI launches activate the existing window without restarting bottle preparation or duplicating signals.
Report bottle worker failures instead of terminating WineGUI.
Expose additional Wine build variants, including NTSync, FSync and release candidates.
Fix runner download concurrency, cancellation, cleanup and failure handling.
Preserve bottle configuration when UseWine64 is absent and cache runner versions for faster bottle selection.
Download and manage alternative Wine and GE-Proton runner builds directly from WineGUI.
Reorder bottle creation around runner selection with WoW64 awareness.
Add Gallium Nine Standalone and expand Visual C++ runtime installers.
Right-click context menu on the bottle list (Edit, Configure, Clone, Run..., Delete)
One-click DXVK GPU test in the application list
Performance overlay (HUD) options in the edit machine window
New AppImage build: single-file, distro-agnostic
Create menu/desktop application shortcuts
Single-click Wine Mono (re)install button in the Configure window
Restored main toolbar overflow menu and refreshed Configure sidebar layout
Faster startup via in-memory registry file caching
Various bug fixes and build/CI improvements
